sentences.text: MAYA KOTWAR W/O SHRI GURUCHARAN SINGH, AGED  ABOUT 50 YEARS, OCCUPATION: HOUSEWIFE R/O
RAMNIWAS SINGH WARD KATNI, RANGNATH, NAGAR  KATNI, DISTRICT KATNI (MADHYA PRADESH)

(BY SHRI AKASH SINGHAI, ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION KOTWALI DISTRICT KATNI (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI A. S. PATHAK, GOVT. ADVOCATE )
This application coming on for admission this day,

the c  following:
 ORDER 1.

This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 26.8.2022 in connection with Crime No.136/2021, registered at Police Station Kotwali District Katni for the offence punishable under Sections 409, 405, 420 and 34 of the IPC.
2. Counsel for the applicant submitted that main accused in the case namely Manjula Agrawal has already been released on bail.
Other co-accused person namely Rahul Dahiya has also been enlarged on bail.
It is submitted that applicant is also ready to deposit Rs. 1 lakh under protest to show his bonafide.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the application and submitted that Manjula Agrawal has deposited Rs. 3 lakhs and other co-accused person namely Rahul Dahiya has deposited Rs. 1,50,000/- under protest.
It is submitted that total breach of trust is in respect of Rs. 6 lakhs.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Other co-accused persons had already been released on bail on deposit of some amount under protest.
6. Considering the aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed on condition that applicant will deposit Rs. 1 lakh under protest to show his bonafide.
Said amount will be kept in the FDR by the Court and shall be subject to final judgment passed in criminal case.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for her appearance before the trial Court on the dates fixed by that Court as and when directed.

8. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE DUBEY/-
